title: repo-guard project configuration
description: Project-level dependency governance, protected-file, structured-exception, hard Vue security and accessibility, staged quality, architecture, TypeScript, build, unit-test, notification, and Vue Lighthouse rules consumed by @cxyi7/repo-guard.

notification.description: Project-wide WeCom notification switch. Missing values stay enabled for compatibility.

enabled.description: Require WeCom delivery for notify-level rules. When false, protected changes are still recorded but no notification is sent.

exceptions.description: Human-reviewed, exact-location exceptions shared by repo-guard rules. Expired entries block normal commands.

warningDays.description: Number of days before expiry when an active exception enters warning state. Must be less than maxDays.

maxDays.description: Maximum allowed number of days between createdOn and expiresOn.

rule.description: Namespaced repo-guard rule id, for example vue/no-v-html, vue/form-control-label, or vue/img-alt.

path.description: One exact repository-relative file; globs and parent traversal are forbidden.

owner.description: Person or team responsible for removing the exception.

approvedBy.description: Independent human approver; runtime validation rejects the owner.

ticket.description: Reviewable issue, risk-acceptance, or remediation ticket.

dependencyPolicy.description: Govern package.json declarations and npm package-lock root metadata.

enabled.description: Run dependency governance when root package.json or package-lock.json is staged. New init configurations set this to true; migrated configurations stay false.

requireExactVersions.description: Require exact versions outside peerDependencies; approved npm aliases and workspace protocols remain supported.

requireLockfile.description: Require package-lock.json v2+ and exact agreement between its root declaration and package.json.

allowedProtocols.description: Explicit dependency source protocols allowed outside normal registry versions. Use protocol names without colons.

bannedPackages.description: Project-owned denylist with reviewable reasons and optional replacements.

architecture.description: Project-wide dependency architecture gate configured and executed by repo-guard through the consuming project's dependency-cruiser installation, with standalone AI repair instructions for blocking violations.

enabled.description: Run dependency architecture rules from the managed pre-push hook. Init enables this only when dependency-cruiser and the configured source paths are available.

sourcePaths.description: Repository-relative files, directories, or globs passed to dependency-cruiser.

tsConfig.description: Repository-relative TypeScript config. Null automatically uses tsconfig.json when it exists.

exclude.description: dependency-cruiser exclusion regex. Null disables the repo-guard exclusion.

rules.description: Forbidden dependency-cruiser rules. Error violations block the gate; warn and info violations remain visible in the unified report.

build.description: Project-owned production build script run explicitly or from the managed pre-push hook.

enabled.description: Run the configured production build automatically from the managed pre-push hook. Init enables this only when the script is already available.

script.description: Name of the consuming project's npm production-build script.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum runtime for the project build process.

lighthouse.description: Vue Lighthouse CI runner. The consuming project owns @lhci/cli, Chrome, routes, assertions, and lighthouserc configuration.

enabled.description: Run the Vue Lighthouse gate automatically from the managed pre-push hook. The explicit repo-guard lighthouse command can run while this is false.

configFile.description: Repository-relative Lighthouse CI config file. Null detects a standard lighthouserc filename.

buildScript.description: Project npm script run before Lighthouse collection. Null skips the build step.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout applied separately to the build, collect, and assert processes.

typeCheck.description: Project-owned TypeScript type-check script run explicitly or from the managed pre-push hook.

enabled.description: Run the configured TypeScript type-check script automatically from the managed pre-push hook. Init enables this only when the script is already available.

script.description: Name of the consuming project's npm script that runs tsc, vue-tsc, or an equivalent full-project type check.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum runtime for the TypeScript type-check process.

accessibilityTest.description: Project-owned axe component or E2E accessibility tests run explicitly or from the managed pre-push hook.

enabled.description: Run static axe test policy checks followed by the configured accessibility test script from pre-push. Init enables this only for a complete supported axe setup.

script.description: Name of the consuming project's npm script dedicated to axe accessibility tests.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum runtime for the accessibility test process.

testPatterns.description: Repository-relative globs for files that must directly execute axe and assert zero violations.

unitTest.description: JavaScript/TypeScript/Vue unit-test, coverage, and pre-push Vitest gate. The consuming project owns Vitest, its coverage provider, test environment, configuration, and tests.

enabled.description: Run missing-test and bypass checks followed by the configured unit-test script from the managed pre-push hook. Init enables this only when Vitest and the script are already available.

script.description: Name of the consuming project's npm script used to run unit tests.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum runtime for the unit-test process.

oneOf.description: Legacy compatibility mode: only append --coverage without repo-guard threshold enforcement.

enabled.description: Generate fresh json-summary and lcov reports and enforce all configured thresholds.

reportsDirectory.description: Dedicated repository-relative coverage directory where Vitest writes coverage-summary.json and lcov.info; the final path segment must contain coverage because Vitest cleans this directory.

coverage.description: Vitest coverage execution plus optional repo-guard global and changed-line hard thresholds.

componentInteraction.description: Static Vue component interaction-test semantics enforced before the existing unit-test script runs; it does not start a second test process.

enabled.description: Require interactive Vue components to have a test that directly imports and mounts the component, performs a wrapper interaction, and asserts an outcome afterward.

componentPatterns.description: Repository-relative Vue component globs subject to interaction-test semantics when their templates contain v-on/@ events or v-model.

requireTests.description: Require colocated tests only for newly added/copied source files, or for every changed source file.

sourcePatterns.description: Repository-relative JavaScript, TypeScript, JSX, TSX, and Vue source globs that require a mapped test file.

testPatterns.description: Repository-relative test globs scanned for empty tests and forbidden .skip, .skipIf, .todo, and .only calls while ignoring comments and literals.

sourcePattern.description: Repository-relative source glob. The first matching mapping wins.

testTemplates.description: Allowed test paths using {dir}, {name}, {path}, and {ext}; each template must include {name} or {path}.

mappings.description: Ordered source-to-test mappings. A source passes when any generated candidate contains an effective test case.

exclusions.description: Source paths excluded from the missing-test requirement, such as entry points and generated files.

preCommit.description: Staged quality gates. Hard Vue v-html and target=_blank rel-security checks run independently without disable switches. Missing configurable defaults can be materialized with repo-guard migrate.

filePlacement.description: Configurable staged and full-project file location policy.

enabled.description: Automatically enforce file placement in pre-commit. Explicit full-project checks still use the configured rules when this switch is false.

mode.description: newFiles checks added, copied, and renamed paths; changedFiles checks every non-deleted staged matching file.

name.description: Human-readable file category used in AI repair instructions.

patterns.description: Case-insensitive repository-relative globs selecting files for this rule. The first matching rule wins.

allowedPatterns.description: Repository-relative locations allowed for matching files.

exceptions.description: Special matching files exempt from this rule.

suggestedDirectory.description: Concrete repository-relative directory proposed to AI when a file is misplaced.

maxFileLines.description: Maximum physical line counts for complete staged files, evaluated after formatting and lint verification.

enabled.description: Reject staged files that exceed the first matching rule and print standalone AI refactoring instructions. New init configurations set this to true; omitted values stay false for upgrade compatibility.

mode.description: strict always rejects an over-limit file; noRegression allows an existing over-limit file only while its staged line count does not exceed its HEAD baseline. New files remain strict.

warnAt.description: Non-blocking warning threshold expressed as a fraction of maxLines.

pattern.description: Repository-relative glob matched against staged file paths.

maxLines.description: Maximum allowed physical line count, including comments and blank lines.

exclusions.description: Repository-relative globs excluded before line-limit rules are matched.

stylelint.description: Stylelint gate loaded from the consuming project's installation and configuration.

enabled.description: Run the consuming project's Stylelint against staged style files before the protected-file gate.

pattern.description: Glob used to select staged files for Stylelint.

fix.description: Apply Stylelint auto-fixes before the final verification pass.

maxWarnings.description: Maximum Stylelint warning count allowed by the commit gate.

requireConfig.description: Require a project Stylelint configuration when the staged gate is enabled.

complexity.description: Repo-owned selector and nesting limits executed with the consuming project's Stylelint and syntax configuration.

enabled.description: Enforce selector-max-compound-selectors and max-nesting-depth on staged style files. New projects with a ready Stylelint setup enable this; migrated projects stay disabled.

maxCompoundSelectors.description: Maximum compound selector count in one resolved selector.

enabled.description: Run Prettier against staged files before the protected-file gate. New init configurations set this to true; omitted values stay false for upgrade compatibility.

pattern.description: Glob used to select staged files for Prettier.

fix.description: Format staged files automatically; false performs a check-only gate.

requireConfig.description: Require a project Prettier configuration for every matched file.

eslint.description: ESLint is loaded from the consuming project. The optional repo-guard preset is injected as a base Flat Config, then the project's own ESLint configuration is loaded and may override it.

enabled.description: Run ESLint against staged files before the protected-file gate. New init configurations set this to true; omitted values stay false for upgrade compatibility.

preset.description: Automatically inject the repo-guard AI maintainability preset before the project's ESLint Flat Config. New init configurations set this to true; omitted values stay false for upgrade compatibility.

pattern.description: lint-staged glob used to select staged files.

fix.description: Apply ESLint auto-fixes before the final verification pass.

maxWarnings.description: Maximum ESLint warning count allowed by the commit gate.

pattern.description: Repository-relative glob. * matches one path segment and ** crosses directories.

category.description: Human-readable category included in reports and notifications.

level.description: notify requires successful delivery when notification.enabled is true; audit only records the change.
